segments.he: וּמֵימֵר. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן לְתַנָּא: לָא תִּתְנִי ״וּמֵימֵר״, מִשּׁוּם דִּבְדִיבּוּרוֹ עָשָׂה מַעֲשֶׂה.
segments.en: § In listing those who incur the punishment of lashes even though they did not perform an action in their transgression, Rabbi Yosei HaGelili was cited above as including: «And one who effects substitution.» The Gemara adds: «Rabbi Yoḥanan said to the tanna» who would recite the baraitot in his academy: «Do not teach: And one who effects substitution,» in this regard, «because» one who effects substitution «performs an action» of consecration «by his speech.»
